_note: Google reviews pasted by Yordan on 2026-10-03. 'text' is the reviewer's own words, copied exactly (an ending '…' means Google cut the review off there). 'en' is our translation and is always labeled as one. The two reviewers named Yordanis (Ulloa Roque and Garcia) share a first name with the driver. Asked whether they are customers rather than family or staff, Yordan answered 'no they are not family' (comment on the site report, 2026-10-07), so their reviews are shown. Any review marked "pending": true shows highlighted in preview builds and is left out of production builds. Left out entirely: Gretel Gallardo's (place name 'kaicora' is unclear to translate), and six reviews that were pasted in Google's Spanish machine translation of English originals (Nicole Brengel, Katie Dasher, jamie cook, Mario Betancourt, orlando lopez, Eliana Mesa Alvarez). Those six can be added once we have the English originals from the Google profile. Star ratings were not in the paste, so none are shown per review.
